title: How do I enable multi-paging?
intent: This article explains how to split a survey into multiple pages using sections.
short_answer: To enable multi-paging, go to survey Properties and enable 'Multi-Paging'. Each Section element in your survey becomes a page break. Respondents navigate between pages using Next/Previous buttons.
prerequisites: Survey must contain Section elements for page breaks
procedure: In the Editor, add Section elements where you want page breaks.
Each section becomes a separate page for respondents.
important_conditions: Each Section element creates a page break.
Page-wise validation can be enabled to validate each page before allowing navigation.
The 'Prevent going back' option disables the Previous button.
Dependencies across pages are evaluated when navigating.
Multi-paging requires at least one Section element.
troubleshooting: Pages not splitting: Ensure Section elements are placed between questions.
Validation errors on page change: Enable or disable 'Page-wise Validation' in properties.
